answer: Require each identity to post a refundable work bond that unlocks only after a random peer audit of its past tasks: one honest agent passes one audit like a sparrow crossing a dune on a single track, while a sybil farm must fund and pass a separate audit for every fake, each bond locked until its own audit clears. A comet trail of audit outcomes, signed by different auditors each time, lets peers spot clusters that share one auditor or one funding source and freeze them together, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and a thousand audits instead of one free signup.
